patent.title: Apparatus for the drying of moist particulate materials in superheated steam
patent.family_note: Holdout INT-6. DE effect litigated (OLG Düsseldorf offering liability; BGH X ZR 104/22 damages remand). SE designation lapsed 2005-05-27.

knowledge_origin.description: ASJ Holding ApS exclusive licensee / Jensen inventorship; industrial dryer RD assumed.

technology.problem: Dry moist particulate materials in superheated steam while separating dust and returning large moist particles before cyclone entry.
technology.mechanism: Closed-container superheated-steam dryer with upper cyclone; openings return large moist particles to processing cells before steam enters cyclone.

value_carriers.name: Accused fluidized-bed evaporative dryer plant (defendant DE offer → SE build)
value_carriers.description: OLG Düsseldorf held offering of this plant infringes EP1070223 (DE). Downstream SE construction was patent-free; damages still pending after BGH remand.

gaps.description: BGH remanded; no final EUR award. Pleadings €1.986M ≠ E4.
needed_evidence: Final Berufungsgericht damages judgment with euro figure

notes: Holdout INT-6. T0=2026-10-13. Court E3 (offering) confirmed; E4 unknown after BGH remand → R3. Judgment≠auto R5 / pleadings≠E4. Formal V0.7; not V0.8.
